== Build notes ==
Magazine dest 23 October 2026. Pages 64–65 from Internet Archive item starwarsinsider_1_to_153_plus_specials, file Star Wars Insider 043 (1999). Wiki Files already uploaded 16 October 2026. Transcription from the opened page scans. Internet Archive djvu OCR is garbled and was not dested.

Printed Philip Jacobs piped to [[Philipp Jacobs]]. Lightside and Darkside print as one word. Sealed Deck, one 40 card deck, go onto, Vice-President, and reenacted (wrap reen-acted) follow the scan. Player-card flavor boxes and the trophy-case location graphic are transcribed. Pull quote on page 65 repeats the 56-competitors sentence from page 64. Trailer line joined across the pull-quote band. Last line ends with a Rebel Alliance glyph, omitted in the transcript. Hernandez card prints destiny 2 over 3. No personal street address or email on pages 64–65. Remainder of issue 43 is outside the SWCCG article.
